examples.name: Command
examples.summary: The agent asks to run a deployment command: the question names it in code, the body shows exactly what will run, and Deny or Deploy decide; the card then shows the outcome in text.

examples.name: Irreversible
examples.summary: A destructive request: the frame and the Delete button turn danger, and Delete stays disabled until the reader types the domain name.

examples.name: Resolved
examples.summary: The three outcomes that stay in the thread after a decision: Approved, Denied and Request expired, each in text with its status dot.
